Diarva Tech / Privacy

Privacy and your choices.

Updated October 30, 2026

Contacting our team

Our contact links open your email or phone application. If you contact us, we receive the information you choose to share and use it to respond to your enquiry and discuss the requested services. Please avoid sending sensitive information in an initial enquiry.

Optional website analytics

When Google Analytics is configured, we ask before loading it. If you accept, we measure page views and interactions such as email, phone, map, service, and portfolio clicks. A click is an interaction, not proof that an enquiry was sent or a sale was made.

Our analytics integration removes query strings and fragments from page locations, does not send contact email addresses or phone numbers as event values, and disables Google advertising signals and ad personalization in its website configuration. Google may process technical information associated with analytics requests. Analytics configuration and account settings also affect processing.

Accepting, declining, or changing analytics

You can decline optional analytics and continue using the website. When analytics is configured, the Analytics settings control in the footer lets you change your choice. We store your choice locally in your browser for up to six months. Declining blocks our analytics integration; it does not block the website itself.

When no analytics property is configured, our Google Analytics integration remains off. Changing your choice affects subsequent collection by this integration; it does not remove information already processed by Google.

Other services

This website uses hosting services to deliver pages and Google Fonts to display typefaces. Requests to those services may include technical information such as your IP address. Links to Google Maps and portfolio websites open services with their own privacy practices.
